regra: The join key (chave) of a name ANVISA gives no id, such as a device manufacturer: trim; map º → o, ª → a, ™ → tm, ² → 2, ³ → 3 (DuckDB's strip_accents drops them); strip accents (NFKD, every combining mark of category M* dropped); lowercase; remove every character outside [a-z0-9]. Letters with no decomposition (ß, Ł, Ø, CJK) are removed, not transliterated. Known divergences between Python's NFKD and DuckDB's strip_accents left out on purpose because no real name has them: ½ (NFKD gives 12), the ﬁ ligature and full-width letters. The data side computes it with derivar.chave_sql; the site with chave() and chaveSql().
